purpose: Define what each premium source must add before AIFundOS treats it as decision-grade evidence.

options.current: Yahoo/yfinance delayed chain snapshot with contract-level paper gates
options.activation_test: Run a measured bakeoff on SPY, QQQ, AMD, NVDA, and MSFT before changing the data-quality score.

institutional_crowding.current: Quiver off-exchange starter context plus public SEC ownership filings
institutional_crowding.activation_test: Measure whether the source changes or improves at least 20 paper decisions before relying on it.

research_notes.current: Benzinga analyst actions and public company/SEC material; no full broker-note text
minimum_upgrade_fields: licensed thesis text with citation and entitlement metadata
research_notes.activation_test: Store provenance and entitlement metadata; never scrape or infer paywalled note text.

human_boundaries: AIFundOS may identify and compare providers but may not buy a subscription or accept commercial terms.
API keys and licensed documents must be supplied by the human operator.
Missing premium data lowers confidence or blocks a strategy; it is never fabricated.
